title: New York musicians: Baby Dodds, Pops Foster, Zutty, Parenti
summary: They ask who was around New York: Baby Dodds after a stroke, Pops Foster, Zutty Singleton and Tony Parenti.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I'm trying to think. Was Simeon around at that time? Did he start to play at Ryan's?

I don't remember Simeon being around then, no. But he came in later with Wilbur de Paris. Pops Foster? Pops Foster was there, yes. Yes. I remember I played with Pops Foster. In fact, I went with Wellstead up to Pops Foster's house. He was a delightful man. Very charming host.
Did you meet Barney Bigard? No. I thought in connection with your clarinet. I ran into him. Zooty.
Zooty. Yes. I've worked with Zooty at the Central Plaza. I remember that now.
Was Peretti in New York at that time?
Yeah, Peretti was around. I remember seeing him a lot.
Because he and Wellstead worked a lot later. Yes. Right. Did Janice have any steady jobs in this period that you were with him?
